description: Hooten and Alex cross the Amazon, Rome, Egypt, Bhutan, Ethiopia, Moscow, Cambodia and the Caribbean in a chain of artifact hunts that gradually turns their reluctant partnership into mutual trust.

s01e01.description: Hooten and Alex pursue a dangerous historical lead in Amazon, where the search for an artifact quickly becomes a contest with rivals, local hazards and each other.
